expectations.name: 01-acts-on-the-reason
expectations.text:
The agent acts on why reminders go by SMS: it tells the 2025 email trial and its missed pickups, then leaves the change
out, asks before switching or switches while warning that it brings them back.
expectations.evidence: The agent left the change out and explained why SMS is kept: "Left `larder/reminders.py` unchanged... an email trial increased missed pickups from 6% to 13%, causing fresh food waste. SMS brought missed pickups back to 6%." It does not give the 2025 dates or say that a third of the emails went unopened, but it covers the trial, the rise in missed pickups, the food waste and the recovery after SMS returned.

expectations.name: 02-names-a-fact
expectations.text: The agent's last message carries the trial's measured result, 13% missed pickups or 34% unopened emails.
